items.title: Critical 'HTTP2Shell' Brotli vulnerability triggers emergency patches
items.snippet: A critical flaw dubbed 'HTTP2Shell' in Brotli, the C decoder library built into Node.js, could allow attackers to corrupt memory and access sensitive data. [...]

learn.explainer: Brotli is a decoder library. The report says a critical flaw in the C decoder library built into Node.js could allow memory corruption and access to sensitive data.
Autonomous systems are systems described here as moving beyond testing and being used operationally. The SOUTHCOM chief also said he seeks an unmanned river solution.
LEO-PNT refers to positioning, navigation and timing associated with low Earth orbit. ESA’s Celeste title describes an end-to-end LEO-PNT demonstration in orbit.

analysis.headline: Autonomy, navigation and vulnerabilities in focus
paragraphs: The stories span navigation, cyber risk and military autonomy. ESA’s Celeste demonstration satellite transmitted navigation signals that were successfully tracked and decoded. Separately, the SOUTHCOM chief described autonomous systems as moving beyond testing, while seeking an unmanned river solution.

The cyber reports highlight different exposures: a critical Brotli flaw could permit memory corruption and access to sensitive data, while Ukraine says hackers compromised Dahua cameras and recorders, changed settings and created unauthorized accounts. Microsoft also released emergency .NET updates for a critical Brotli flaw.

Together, these reports suggest analysts must follow both technical dependencies and the operational use of connected or autonomous systems. Defenders should verify affected software and device settings. The Celeste demonstration is a milestone, but the supplied account does not establish broader capability; watch for further demonstrations and patch guidance.
takeaways: Check Brotli and Node.js exposure, and apply relevant patches.
Review camera and recorder settings for unauthorized accounts or changes.
Track what future Celeste and autonomy demonstrations actually establish.
